narr: Thunderstorms moved northwest across southeast Arizona from late morning into early evening. Flash flooding occurred near Three Points and in Sabino and Bear Canyons where a large group of people became stranded. A dust storm rolled across Interstate 10 in Pinal County.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5 in 1 hour caused flash flooding southeast of Three Points including Sierra Mountain Rd.

Heavy rain of 2-3 at the headwaters of Sabino Creek and Bear Canyon caused rapid rises in both streams. Flash flooding occurred at the Sabino Canyon Recreation area causing damage to trails and flooding of all recreation area bridges. Twenty five people became stranded in Bear Canyon and needed to be rescued as trails across the wash were flowing heavily and dangerously impassable. No injuries were reported.
lsr: FLOODING REPORTED ON SIERRITA MOUNTAIN ROAD NORTH OF HILLTOP ROAD.
